<observations>
Date: Mar 20, 2026
* 🔴 User adopted strict TypeScript null checks and switched production database from SQLite to PostgreSQL.
* 🔴 SOC 2 audit fieldwork scheduled for May 19, 2026.
* 🟡 Enhanced CI pipeline with node_modules caching, 85% Jest coverage threshold, and ESLint checks.

Date: Mar 23, 2026
* 🔴 User adopted semantic commit messages for all commits.
* 🔴 Public API rate limit set to 300 requests per minute.
* ✅ Merged PR #42 adding discount code validation with LaunchDarkly feature flag (reviewed by @sara).
* 🟡 Refactored invoice PDF generation using pdf-lib.

Date: Mar 26, 2026
* ✅ Merged PR #58 adding locale-aware date formatting (reviewed by @mike).
* 🟡 Implemented overdue invoice email notifications (nodemailer), pino JSON logging, and ConfigCat "recurringPause" feature toggle.

Date: Mar 29, 2026
* 🔴 Public API rate limit raised to 500 requests per minute.
* ✅ Deployed dark mode UI feature to staging (Percy visual tests) and added bulk invoice upload endpoint for Excel files via SheetJS.

Date: Apr 2, 2026
* ✅ Merged recurring invoice templates feature into develop (approved by @kim), complete with pdfmake watermarks and BullMQ async job processing.

Date: Apr 6, 2026
* 🔴 User integrated Stripe for subscription payments and added QR codes to payment receipt emails.
* 🟡 Added nightly DB cleanup script, Snyk security scanning in CI, and evaluated Redis Streams for background jobs.
* ✅ Merged Stripe integration feature into main (approved by @alex).
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: None active (awaiting user direction following the successful Stripe integration merge).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
- "The Stripe integration has been successfully merged into main. What would you like to work on next?"
</suggested-response>
